workstream: WS-5 AI Agent Architecture, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent SDK, Context Engineering & Tooling Integration

E1.title: MCP Protocol Specification Baseline & Modular v2 SDK Architecture Audit
E1.methodology: Official MCP specification audit (2026-07-28 & 2025-11-25) and v2 modular SDK source inspection

protocolBaseline.backwardCompatibilityStatus: v2 servers can negotiate protocol versions during initialize handshake with older clients

modularPackagesV2.httpFrameworkAdapters: Modular transport bindings for Node.js http, Express, Fastify

stdio.nature: Standard input/output stream over parent/child process pipes
stdio.securityModel: Inherits local operating-system process and pipe permissions; zero open network ports; no bearer tokens or HTTP auth required
stdio.suitability: Primary local transport for CLI, IDE extensions, and desktop coding agents
stdio.loggingInvariant: stdout is strictly reserved for valid JSON-RPC frames; all diagnostics must route to stderr

streamableHttp.nature: Single unified HTTP POST endpoint accepting JSON-RPC and streaming responses
architecturalChanges2026: Single MCP endpoint accepts all POST requests
Protocol-level sessions removed in favor of transport headers and connection state
Applicable remote security: When exposed over networks, requires TLS encryption, HTTP authorization (e.g. Bearer tokens), and CORS/CSRF origin controls
streamableHttp.suitability: Remote verification workers and containerized execution nodes

lifecycleStages: 1. Client spawns server process or connects to HTTP endpoint
2. Client sends initialize request (clientInfo, capabilities, protocolVersion)
3. Server responds with serverInfo, capabilities, instructions, negotiated protocolVersion
4. Client sends initialized notification to complete handshake
5. Operational requests: tools/list, tools/call, resources/list, resources/read, prompts/list
6. Bi-directional notifications: logging, progress, tool/resource updates
7. Termination: transport close or SIGTERM process shutdown

primitives.tools: Model-controlled executable actions returning text, image, or resource content
primitives.resources: Application-controlled context data attachments (files, AST graphs, design tokens)
primitives.prompts: User-controlled parameterized slash commands and prompt templates
primitives.roots: Client-defined filesystem boundary paths restricting server operations
primitives.sampling: Server-initiated LLM completions routed through client approval

E1.architecturalFinding: MCP is an RPC transport adapter for tools and resources; UIForge Core remains independent of MCP SDK.
